# tidb-rs on TiDB's integration tests (R1)

<!-- Generated by scripts/tracker.py report. Do not edit. -->

Run: tidb-rs `61a69663aa` against Go TiDB v8.5.8, test files from TiDB `4cee7f2084`, 2026-10-30T16:49:44Z on Darwin arm64 Apple M4 Pro, 213 min.

Each `.test` file runs in hybrid mode on one tiup playground: every statement runs on Go TiDB (A) in the file's sessions, as mysql-tester would run it; read statements (SELECT/TABLE/VALUES/WITH, SHOW, EXPLAIN/DESC) also run on tidb-rs (B), in B sessions that mirror A's database and session statements, and B's answer is compared with A's on the same data. Rows (as multisets unless the query has a top-level ORDER BY and no `--sorted_result`), column metadata, error codes, and with `--enable_warnings` the warnings must be equal. A is the reference, not the `.result` files (those are recorded on TiDB master). Details: tidb-rs `tools/ab/README.md`.

## Overall

Score: the share of scored reads (match + mismatch + unsupported + b_error) that match. Reads where A itself failed unexpectedly (`a_error`, mostly features of TiDB master missing in the release) and reads not sent to B (`skipped`) are not scored.

## Mismatches

Every statement where B answered differently from A. `rows`: wrong values or row count; `order`: same rows, different order under ORDER BY; `columns`: column names or count; `metadata`: other column metadata (type, length, flags, charset); `error`: a different error code, or B answered where A failed; `shape`: result set vs OK; `warnings`: different SHOW WARNINGS under `--enable_warnings`. `B rej.`: session statements (SET, USE, ...) B had rejected earlier in that connection, so its session may differ from A's (e.g. SET NAMES gbk).
